note: Humboldt County park at the south tip of Big Lagoon, 7 mi north of Trinidad off US 101: the camp sits in a grove of trees beside the lagoon boat ramp, with an open grass terrace and a beach trail out to the Pacific beach on the west. Sites suit tents and small-to-mid RVs and trailers; not all fit larger rigs. On-site host. --Claude
summary: County pages read: $30 cash/check, 25 sites FCFS, 7-night max, coin showers, host; open. Coastal dunes -> coastal walk recommended (no dune field; open grass terrace, park road and day-use lot to a beach ~90-200 m off). Pin ~190 m onto the campground grove (stored pin was on bluff-top houses).
flags: WATERFRONT coastal dunes -> coastal walk RECOMMENDED: the campground is the tree grove at 41.16316,-124.13156 beside the boat ramp at the lagoon's south tip. West of it lie the park road, an open mown grass terrace and the day-use parking lot, then a low scarp down to the Pacific beach (~90 m to the sand, ~200 m to the surf). That is not the campground's own undeveloped dune field (the stored evidence's 'open grass/low dune ... ~40-70m' was read at the pin by the houses), and a day-use lot sits beside the route, so coastal dunes fails; the park's own road, lot and beach trail with US 101 well inland satisfy coastal walk (county: 'Day-use area with beach and lagoon access', 'Beach Trail'). The lagoon on the east is under canopy from the sites, with the ramp/day-use apron between - no lagoon value shown. Proposed evidence: 'Esri imagery 2026-11-27: campground grove at 41.1632,-124.1316 south of the boat ramp; park road, open grass terrace and day-use lot to a low scarp and the Pacific beach ~90 m (surf ~200 m) west; no dune field; US 101 inland. County page: beach trail, beach and lagoon access.'

PIN MOVE ~190 m: 41.16200,-124.13320 -> 41.16316,-124.13156 (Google's campground point, centre of the tree grove south of the boat ramp). The stored pin is beside a row of private houses on the bluff south of the park.
